title: The Science of Strategy
coreMove: Make the strategic logic causal, challengeable, and refinable before trusting it.
sourcePressure: Strategic thinking becomes rigorous when diagnosis, causality, consequence, challenge, and refinement are explicit instead of slogan-driven or formulaic. Frozen source has no chapter-specific named figure, study, place, or event beyond the visible title/support notes; use conceptual source terms only and do not invent anchors.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The science of strategy means using a formula, model, or certainty machine.
